entities.summary: Gregory John Chaitin is an Argentine-American mathematician and computer scientist. His work was foundational to the development of algorithmic information theory, and has been influential on metamathematics. He independently discovered what is today known as algorithmic complexity simultaneously with Andrei Kolmogorov and Ray Solomonoff.
